pages.text: Load an enchanted book in the typesetting table’s source slot and put chases in the supply stack. Sneak-right-click the source. Stamping consumes the enchanted book and one chase and charges experience levels in survival.

pages.title: Cost and Wear
pages.text: The level cost depends on the book’s enchantments and the server’s printing multiplier. Aim at the source with $(l:bibliocraft:writing/reading)Reading$(/l) to see the cost. Print onto a blank vanilla book with ink. Each successful copy wears the plate.
